summary.short_summary: During a productive three-hour meeting, technical difficulties initially delayed the start but did not hinder positive discussions. Leslie expressed appreciation for the buyer's PR expertise, showing a shift in perception. The buyer prefers month-to-month contracts, contrasting with LFPR's annual contracts, and financial transparency was shared via QuickBooks. A co-branding strategy was proposed, involving Steinway Communications and LFPR for one year before transitioning to just Steinway Communications. An integration plan was outlined to have the buyer on-site for three months, focusing on minimal disruption during the first 90 days. Discussions included a proposed salary for a new Head of Education role and the buyer's preference for direct communication with Leslie and Carl, raising concerns about broker involvement. Notably, Bonner Group's offer was deemed too low, and a Letter of Intent is expected next week, with July 4th week anticipated to affect timelines.
